risk_summary: The excerpt is generally transparent and well quantified, with clear attribution of revenue and expense changes to dispositions, occupancy, leasing spreads, and portfolio performance. Risk exposure is meaningful due to declining rental income and occupancy, retail-sector disruption, tenant credit risk, operating-cost inflexibility, natural disasters, and debt extinguishment costs, although management presents a moderately constructive operating outlook.
